description: Land Acquisition - Atambaoya and Kawduluwewa, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing the acquisition of particular land parcels for road construction under a development project. It contains detailed descriptions of the lands to be acquired, including lot numbers, land names, claimants, encroacher details, and land extents. The notice is issued under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act and deals with property ownership and government land acquisition matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
